title: Mindful Eating Unofficial Port (AI)
description: A completely AI-modified fork of Mindful Eating Unofficial Port.
body:
This is an **AI-assisted** fork of Mindful Eating Unofficial Port.

The primary focus of this fork is to ensure compatibility with Legendary Survival Overhaul. As part of this effort, the dependency on Blueprint has been completely removed in the latest release.

Future maintenance may be provided. Everyone is welcome to use it.

For more details, please visit the GitHub repository.

Special thanks to [camcam\_burger](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mindful-eating), the creator of the original mod, and [outrightwings](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mindful-eating-unofficial-port) for the initial port.
